Indicators the Bayesian coverage model can be fitted for

Source: R/page-bayesian.R
cd_bayes_indicators.Rd

The indicators the Bayesian coverage model has a survey series for. They are the default tabs of the Bayesian page (bayesian_ui()). An app shows only the ones its data has by setting bayes_indicators in options(cd2030.config = ), which the page reads with cd_cfg("bayes_indicators") (the vaccine app: penta3 and measles1).

Usage

cd_bayes_indicators

Format

A character vector of five indicator names: "anc4", "anc_1trimester", "ideliv", "measles1" and "penta3".

Examples

cd_bayes_indicators
#> [1] "anc4"           "anc_1trimester" "ideliv"         "measles1"      
#> [5] "penta3"        

# the tabs an app shows: its own setting, or these
cd_cfg("bayes_indicators", cd_bayes_indicators)
#> [1] "anc4"           "anc_1trimester" "ideliv"         "measles1"      
#> [5] "penta3"
